Ticket created automatically from chargeback alert · Mar 4, 2026 · 3:56 PM
System AlertAuto3:56 PM
Harbor Bistro (merchant ID: MRC-2291) has exceeded the chargeback ratio threshold. Current ratio: 1.8% (threshold: 1.5%). 4 chargebacks filed in the last 7 days totaling $1,240. Processor: First Data. Risk level: High.
Blake C. · Coastal CommerceInternal Note3:58 PM
I just got off the phone with the merchant. They say they had an issue with a catering event last weekend — several guests disputed charges saying they didn't authorize the amount. They're planning to fight the disputes. Should we put a temporary hold on high-ticket transactions until this is resolved?
Harbor Bistro (Merchant) ✉ Email 4:01 PM
Hi, we just got flagged for chargebacks. These were all from our catering event on March 1st — a few guests are disputing the charges but we have signed receipts for all of them. We want to fight these. What do we need to send you?
4:02 PMMaster Admin (You)
Good to know — please send us signed receipts, any event contracts, and the guest authorization forms if you have them. We'll need the transaction IDs from your terminal as well. We're reviewing now and will guide you through the dispute process.
Harbor Bistro (Merchant) 💬 SMS 4:08 PM
Got it. TXNs: TXN-88421, TXN-88430, TXN-88451, TXN-88502 — all March 1. Sending receipts now via email. Total in dispute: $1,240. We have everything signed.
Harbor Bistro (Merchant) 🖥 Portal 4:11 PM
Uploaded 4 signed receipts and the event contract to the portal. File names: receipt_88421.pdf, receipt_88430.pdf, receipt_88451.pdf, receipt_88502.pdf, catering_contract_march1.pdf.
Master Admin (You)Internal Note4:14 PM
Checked all 4 TXNs — no prior fraud flags on the card BINs. Dispute reason codes are all 4853 (Cardholder Dispute, Services Not Rendered). Merchant has submitted full docs. Strong case to fight. Recommend filing representment on all 4. MCA level is fine — no hold needed.
